Retrieve historical observed weather data

Source: R/get_historical_forecast.R
get_historical_weather.Rd

Pulls actual observed weather data (ERA5 reanalysis) from the Open-Meteo Archive API for a given location and date range. Returns data in the same schema as get_historical_forecast with issue_date = NA and lead_days = NA, since observed weather has no forecast lead time.

Usage

get_historical_weather(
  lat = 44.390278,
  lon = -121.406792,
  start_date,
  end_date,
  variables = c("temperature_2m_max", "temperature_2m_min", "cloud_cover_mean"),
  timezone = "UTC"
)

Arguments

lat

Numeric. Latitude of target point.

lon

Numeric. Longitude of target point.

start_date

Character or Date. Start of date range.

end_date

Character or Date. End of date range.

variables

Character vector. Daily variables to retrieve.

timezone

Character. Timezone. Defaults to "UTC".

Value

A tibble with columns: valid_date, issue_date (NA), lead_days (NA), variable, value, units, lat, lon

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_historical_weather(
  lat        = 44.390278,
  lon        = -121.406792,
  start_date = "2011-01-01",
  end_date   = "2019-12-24"
)
} # }
